name: Korcha
source:
"Stop being a baby Orla! lf you'd just go a little faster we could be back home before dark! We haven't run across anyone yet. I doubt they know we've escaped."

Korcha is an Aquarian merman that was forced into captivity. He's very impulsive, quick to anger and stubborn. Sees himself as a protector and is angry when he's unable to save his sister. Blames the MC for his problems and balks at being held a prisoner. Will fight tooth and nail to be free.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=50&t=25540]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
